title: Autonomous mechanism discovery for phosphine-catalysed alkyne–ester stitching
difficulty_reasons: The agent must generate and discriminate a substantially open set of mechanistic hypotheses and transition-state candidates.
The agent must justify search coverage, stopping, connectivity and limitations without route disclosure.

paper.title: Phosphine-Catalyzed Alkyne-Ester Stitching for the Construction of Functionalized Cyclopentenones

data.description: Closed reaction identities, SMILES, charge/multiplicity, endpoint, solvent, temperature and reference boundary.

required_deliverables.description: Hypotheses, candidate records, validated pathway/profile, coverage and conclusion.
